blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS , a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)在视觉理解和推理方面表现优异,但由于视觉标志物数量众多,往往需要大量推论费用. 近期的视觉符号搜索方法越来越遵循两个阶段的范式:首先在视觉编码器后移除视觉冗余符号,然后丢弃与大语言模型(LLM)内文字查询无关的符号. 然而,由于第一阶段通常完全依赖视觉编码的显著性,它可能过早地消除了与查询相关的符号,使随后的文本引导阶段失去了关键的视觉证据. 我们的实证分析显示,将查询指导纳入第一阶段的浏览工作,将更好地保存与任务相关的证据,并持续改进业绩,而不是仅注重视觉的浏览。 我们还发现,高差异的注意力头对文字查询更为敏感,并产生更多对文字到视觉的差别化注意力信号,用于第二阶段的浏览. 基于这些调查结果,我们提议TReVS,一个无培训框架,将文字相关性和视觉编码器的显著性结合起来,用于LLM前的穿透,并利用高差异的注意力头去除LLM的浅层到中间层中与任务相关的符号. 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上,TReVS保留了92.8%的未刷底基准性能,同时刷新了94.4%的视觉标志,比之前最先进的方法表现优异.

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) extend the reasoning of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Touvron et al. 2023 ; Bai et al. 2023 ; Achiam et al. 2023 ) to visual inputs, achieving strong performance in visual question answering, multimodal reasoning, high-resolution image understanding, and video understanding ( Liu et al. 2023 ; Zhu et al. 2023 ; Li et al. 2023a ; Li et al. 2024 ) . Recent VLMs improve fine-grained perception across high-resolution images, multiple images, and videos. This broader coverage, however, produces visual-token sequences substantially longer than text sequences. LLaVA-1.5 encodes each image into 576 visual tokens ( Liu et al. 2024a ) , LLaVA-NeXT uses up to 2,880 tokens per high-resolution image ( Liu et al. 2024b ) , and Qwen2.5-VL processes up to 16,384 visual tokens for multi-image and video inputs ( Bai et al. 2025 ) . These sequences increase computation, latency, and memory use, making visual-token processing a major bottleneck in efficient VLM inference.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)扩展了预先训练的大语言模型(LLMs)的推理(Touvron等人. 2023; Bai等人著. 2023; Achiam et al. 2023)到视觉输入,在视觉问题回答,多式联运推理,高分辨率图像理解,视频理解方面实现强效性能(Liu et al. 2023; 朱等编. 2023; Li等人 2023a; Li等人 2024 ). 最近的VLM改善了高分辨率图像、多幅图像和视频的精细感知。 然而,这种范围较广的覆盖面产生比文本序列长得多的视觉音箱序列。 LLaVA-1.5将每个图像编码为576个视觉符号(Liu等人2024a),LLaVA-NEXT每个高分辨率图像使用高达2,880个符号(Liu等人2024b),Quen2.5-VL处理最多16,384个视觉符号用于多图像和视频输入(Bai等人2025). 这些序列会增加计算,耐久性和内存使用,使得可视化的托盘处理成为高效VLM推论中的一个主要瓶颈.

blocks.en: Visual token pruning addresses this bottleneck by exploiting the substantial redundancy in visual inputs ( Bolya et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2025b ; Yang et al. 2025 ) . Recent methods increasingly adopt a two-stage design that reduces visual redundancy after the vision encoder and then removes textually irrelevant tokens within the LLM ( Takezoe et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026 ; Singh et al. 2026 ) . The pre-LLM stage typically uses vision-encoder saliency or diversity to select tokens. The in-LLM stage uses text-to-vision cross-attention to retain query-relevant tokens. Although this division improves the performance, it creates an information bottleneck. Current pre-LLM pruning remains largely query-agnostic and can discard visual evidence that is essential to the text query. Once removed, such evidence is unavailable to subsequent query-aware pruning. The second stage must therefore identify task-relevant tokens within a potentially incomplete visual context.
blocks.zh: 通过利用视觉投入中的大量冗余,视觉标志性搜索解决了这一瓶颈(Bolya等人)。 2023; 陈等. 2024; 张等. 2025b; Yang 等人,2025年). 近期的方法越来越多地采用双阶段设计,在视觉编码器后减少视觉冗余,然后在LLM内去掉文字上无关的符号(Takezoe等人. 2026; 张等. 2026; 辛格等人 2026 (英语). LLM前期一般使用视觉编码器的显著性或多样性来选择符号. LLM阶段使用文本对视觉的交叉意向来保留与查询相关的符号. 虽然这个司能提高性能,却制造了一个信息瓶颈. 当前的LLM预查仍然基本上属于查询-不可知性,可以丢弃对文本查询至关重要的视觉证据. 一旦被移除,这些证据将无法为以后的查询所了解。 因此,第二阶段必须在可能不完整的视觉背景下确定与任务有关的标志。

blocks.en: We first examine the information loss caused by query-agnostic pre-LLM pruning and obtain two findings. First, incorporating textual relevance into pre-LLM pruning consistently improves performance by preserving query-relevant evidence (Figure 2 (b)). Second, vision-encoder saliency and textual relevance produce distinct token rankings, with negative Spearman correlations across datasets and token budgets (Figure 2 (c)). Together, these results show that textual relevance complements vision-encoder saliency and should be introduced before irreversible token reduction. We then examine the in-LLM stage, where the retained visual tokens are further refined using text-to-vision attention. We find that high-variance attention heads produce more discriminative and query-sensitive attention signals for identifying task-relevant tokens. These findings motivate a coordinated two-stage design: the first stage preserves visually salient, textually relevant, and diverse evidence, while the second uses high-variance heads to remove residual task-irrelevant tokens after cross-modal interaction develops. Section 3 provides detailed evidence for these findings.
blocks.zh: 我们首先检查了LLM前的查询-不可知性搜索导致的信息损失,并获得了两个结果. 首先,将文本相关性纳入LLM预览,通过保存与查询相关的证据,不断提高性能(图2(b))。 其次,视觉编码器的显著性和文字相关性产生了显著的标志性排名,Spearman在数据集和标志性预算之间有着负相关性(图2(c))。 这些结果共同表明,文字相关性是对视觉编码的显著性的补充,应当在不可逆转的象征性减少之前采用。 然后我们审查LLM阶段,利用文字到视觉的注意,对保留下来的视觉标志作进一步的改进。 我们发现,高差异的注意头产生更具有歧视性和对问题敏感的注意信号,以识别与任务相关的符号。 这些结论激励了一个协调的两阶段设计:第一阶段保留了视觉突出、文字相关和各种证据,第二阶段则使用高变异头,在跨模式互动发展后去除与任务无关的剩余标志。 第3节提供了这些调查结果的详细证据。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , we propose TReVS , a training-free framework that coordinates pre-LLM and in-LLM visual token pruning. Before the LLM, TReVS scores visual tokens using [CLS] attention from the penultimate ViT layer and cosine similarity between projected visual tokens and embedded text tokens. It fuses these scores and supplements the top-ranked tokens with a small diversity set. During LLM prefilling, TReVS prunes again at a shallow-to-middle layer, using high-variance text-to-vision attention heads to identify query-relevant tokens. The first stage reduces visual redundancy while preserving salient, textually relevant, and diverse evidence. The second removes the remaining task-irrelevant tokens after cross-modal interaction develops.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们提出TReVS,这是一个无培训框架,协调LLM前和LLM内视觉符号搜索。 在LLM之前,TReVS使用倒数第二VIT层的注意力和预测的视觉符号和嵌入式文字符号之间的余弦相似度来评分视觉符号. 它将这些分数融合起来,用一个小的多样化组合来补充排名最高的代币. 在LLM预填时,TReVS再次在浅层到中层进行翻版,使用高变异文本到视觉的注意头来识别与查询相关的符号. 第一阶段减少视觉冗余,同时保留显著,文字相关,证据多样. 第二种在跨模式互动发展后删除了剩余的与任务无关的符号.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments across vision-language benchmarks show that TReVS outperforms state-of-the-art training-free methods at multiple reduction ratios. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS prunes 94.4% of visual tokens while retaining 92.8% of the original performance. Without additional training, it accelerates prefilling by 2.2 × 2.2\times and end-to-end inference by 1.4 × 1.4\times . These results establish the importance of preserving textual relevance before visual token reduction.
blocks.zh: 跨越各种视觉语言基准的广泛实验表明,TReVS在多重削减比率方面超过了最先进的无培训方法。 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上,TReVS在保留92.8%的原性能的同时,还刷新了94.4%的视觉符号. 在没有额外训练的情况下,它加速了2.2×2.2的预填,1.4×1.4的终到推断. 这些结果确定了在减少视觉信号之前保持文字相关性的重要性。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We show that introducing textual relevance before the first irreversible visual-token reduction preserves query-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance. The rankings induced by textual relevance and vision-encoder saliency remain negatively correlated across datasets and token budgets, showing that the two signals favor complementary visual tokens. • We show that attention variance provides a simple, training-free criterion for identifying query-sensitive attention heads. These heads produce more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for in-LLM pruning. • We introduce TReVS, a training-free two-stage framework that combines vision-encoder saliency, textual relevance, and token diversity before the LLM, then uses high-variance attention heads to remove the remaining task-irrelevant visual tokens within the LLM. TReVS retains 92.8% of the baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们显示,在第一次不可逆的视觉调试还原之前引入文字相关性会保留与查询相关的证据,并持续改善性能. 由文字相关性和视觉编码能力引起的排名在数据集和象征性预算之间仍然呈负相关关系,表明这两个信号有利于互补的视觉符号。 我们显示,注意力差异为识别对询问敏感的注意力头提供了简单、无培训的标准。 这些头部为LLM穿透产生更具有歧视性的文字到视觉的注意信号. ^ 我们引入了TReVS,这是一种无培训的两阶段框架,结合了视觉编码器的显著性,文字相关性,以及LLM之前的象征多样性,然后使用高变异的注意头去除LLM中剩余的与任务无关的视觉符号. TReVS保留了92.8%的基线性能,同时刷新了94.4%的视觉标志.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景-语言模式

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) connect pretrained LLMs with vision encoders through projection modules such as MLPs and Q-Formers ( Liu et al. 2023 ; Zhu et al. 2023 ; Li et al. 2023a ) . Recent VLMs extend visual understanding from standard images to high-resolution images and long videos ( Liu et al. 2024a ; Liu et al. 2024b ; Bai et al. 2025 ; Clark et al. 2026 ; Liu et al. 2026 ) . As image resolution and video duration increase, the resulting visual sequences can substantially exceed the corresponding text sequences, making visual token reduction important for efficient VLM inference.
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)通过MLPs和Q-Formers(Liu等人. 2023; 朱等编. 2023; 李等人 2023a ). 近期的VLM将视觉理解从标准图像扩展到高分辨率图像和长视频(Liu等人,2024a;Liu等人. 2024年b; Bai et al. 2025; Clark等人著. 2026; 刘等 2026). 随着图像分辨率和视频持续时间的增加,由此产生的视觉序列可以大大超过相应的文本序列,使得视觉符号减少对于高效的VLM推论很重要.

blocks.en: 2.2 Visual Token Reduction for VLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 VLM 的视觉切变还原

blocks.en: Existing methods differ primarily in where token reduction occurs and when the text query becomes available.
blocks.zh: 现有方法主要在出现符号减少和文本查询时有所不同。

blocks.en: Vision-guided pre-LLM reduction. These methods remove redundant visual tokens after the vision encoder using visual-side signals such as saliency, similarity, or diversity ( Alvar et al. 2025 ) . VisionZip ( Yang et al. 2025 ) retains dominant tokens according to vision-encoder saliency and merges residual tokens into contextual representations. VisPruner ( Zhang et al. 2025a ) combines vision-encoder attention with similarity-based deduplication. Although these methods reduce computation before the LLM, their selection remains independent of the text query.
blocks.zh: 远景指导 LLM 预削减. 这些方法将视觉编码器之后的冗余视觉符号移除,使用视觉侧面信号如显性,相似性,或多样性(Alvar等人,2025年) . 远景Zip (杨等. 2025年)根据视觉编码的显著性保留了主导标志,并将剩余标志合并为背景表示. 维斯普鲁纳 (张等2025a) 将视觉-编码器的注意与相似性的分解相结合. 虽然这些方法减少了LLM之前的计算,但其选择仍然独立于文本查询.

blocks.en: Query-aware in-LLM pruning. These methods prune within the LLM using text-to-vision cross-attention to retain task-relevant visual information. FastV ( Chen et al. 2024 ) performs attention-based pruning in shallow LLM layers, PyramidDrop ( Xing et al. 2024 ) progressively reduces tokens as visual redundancy increases with depth, and SparseVLM ( Zhang et al. 2025b ) combines text-guided attention with rank-adaptive sparsity. Since all visual tokens first enter the LLM, pruning often occurs in very shallow layers to provide meaningful computational savings. At these layers, text-to-vision cross-attention is susceptible to attention shift and dispersion ( Zhang et al. 2025a ) , which can cause substantial accuracy loss.
blocks.zh: 腾讯-知觉在LLMPruning. 这些方法在LLM中通过文字对视觉的交叉注意来保留与任务相关的视觉信息. 快车 (Chen等人,2024年)在浅层LLM中进行基于注意力的 p,PyramidDrop(Xing等人,2024年)随着视觉冗余度随深度的增加而逐渐减少符号,SparseVLM(Zhang等人,2025年b)结合了文本引导的注意度和等级调整的 spa. 由于所有视觉符号都先进入LLM,所以推算经常在非常浅的层中发生,以提供有意义的计算节省. 在这些层次上,文本对视觉的交叉注意容易引起注意力的转移和分散(Zhang等人,2025a),这可能会造成重大的准确性损失.

blocks.en: Two-stage pruning. Recent methods combine pre-LLM visual reduction with query-guided refinement inside the LLM ( Zhang et al. 2026 ; Singh et al. 2026 ; Takezoe et al. 2026 ) . DUET-VLM ( Singh et al. 2026 ) first merges redundant tokens through local clustering and then performs layer-wise pruning using cross-modal attention. LearnPruner ( Takezoe et al. 2026 ) replaces vision-encoder attention with a learnable pre-LLM importance predictor and performs text-guided pruning in intermediate LLM layers. This design reduces early computation while allowing the second stage to use more mature cross-modal interactions.
blocks.zh: 二阶普润. 近代方法结合了LLM视觉前还原和LLM内部的查询引导完善(张等. 2026; 辛格等人著. 2026; Takezoe et al. 2026 (英语). DUET-VLM(Singh等人,2026年)首先通过本地集群合并了多余的符号,然后利用跨模式的注意来进行层层的推敲. LearnPruner(Takezoe等人,2026年)用一个可学习的LLM前重要预测器取代视觉编码器的注意,并在中间LLM层中进行文字导读. 这种设计减少了早期的计算,同时允许第二阶段使用更成熟的跨模式交互.

blocks.en: Existing two-stage methods typically separate visual-only pre-LLM reduction from query-aware in-LLM pruning. In contrast, TReVS coordinates query guidance across both stages: textual relevance complements vision-encoder saliency before the LLM, while query-sensitive attention further refines the retained tokens within the LLM. This design reduces visual redundancy without depriving the second stage of query-relevant context.
blocks.zh: 现有的两阶段方法一般将只视觉的LLM前还原与查询-意识的LLM穿透分离. 相比之下,TReVS协调了两个阶段的查询指导:文本相关性在LLM之前补充了视觉编码器的显著性,而对查询敏感的注意则进一步完善了LLM内部保留符号. 这种设计在不剥夺第二阶段查询相关上下文的情况下减少了视觉冗余.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminary Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 初步分析

blocks.en: 3.1 Does textual guidance improve performance?
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 文字指导是否提高性能?

blocks.en: Two-stage methods typically use vision-encoder saliency or diversity signals for pre-LLM pruning and query-aware attention for in-LLM pruning. This mismatch creates an irreversible bottleneck: query-relevant evidence removed before the LLM cannot be recovered later. We therefore ask: Can textual guidance during pre-LLM pruning preserve such evidence and improve performance?
blocks.zh: 两级方法一般使用视觉编码器的显著性或多样性信号进行LLM前推和对LLM前推的注意和对查询的注意. 这种不匹配造成了一个不可逆转的瓶颈:在LLM以后无法恢复之前删除了与查询相关的证据. 因此,我们问:在LLM调查前的文字指导能否保存这种证据并改进性能?

blocks.en: We evaluate LLaVA-1.5-7B on MME ( Fu et al. 2023 ) , POPE ( Li et al. 2023b ) , TextVQA ( Singh et al. 2019 ) , and GQA ( Hudson and Manning 2019 ) . Under a fixed token budget, we vary the allocation between vision-encoder saliency, measured by [CLS] attention in the penultimate ViT layer, and textual relevance, measured by cosine similarity between projected visual tokens and text embeddings.
blocks.zh: 我们评价LLaVA-1.5-7B的MME(Fu等人,2023年),POPE(Li等人,2023年b),TextVQA(Singh等人,2019年),以及GQA(Hudson和Manning,2019年). 在一个固定的符号预算下,我们将视觉-编码器的显著性与文字相关性之间的分配,用倒数第二维T层的注意度(CLS)来衡量,用预测视觉符号和文字嵌入式的同位素相似度来衡量。

blocks.en: Figure 2 (a) illustrates their complementary behavior. Vision-encoder saliency favors the dominant fire hydrant, while textual relevance recovers the car targeted by the query. Their integration retains both sources of evidence.
blocks.zh: 图2(a)显示了它们的互补行为。 视觉-编码器的显著性偏向于主流的消防栓,而文字相关性则恢复了被查询对象的汽车. 它们的整合保留了两种证据来源。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 (b), allocating even a modest fraction of the budget to textual relevance consistently outperforms visual-only pruning. Figure 2 (c) further shows negative Spearman correlations between the two scores among the top- K K saliency-selected tokens across all datasets and budgets. Thus, textual relevance reorders even visually salient candidates and complements, rather than replaces, vision-encoder saliency. Together, these results show that textual guidance contributes complementary selection information and improves performance under a fixed token budget.
blocks.zh: 如图2(b)所示,即使将预算的一小部分用于文字相关性,其效果也始终高于仅用于视觉的浏览。 图2(c)进一步显示,在所有数据集和预算中,在K至高K高K高K高K高K高K高标分中,Spearman两个分数之间的负相关关系。 因此,文字相关性甚至会重新排列视觉显著的候选者,并补充而不是取代视觉编码的显著性。 这些结果表明,文字指导有助于补充选择信息,并在固定符号预算下改善业绩。

blocks.en: 3.2 Are High-Variance Attention Heads More Query-Sensitive?
blocks.zh: 3.2 高度关注头目是否更敏感?

blocks.en: Several in-LLM pruning methods average text-to-vision attention across all heads ( Chen et al. 2024 ; Takezoe et al. 2026 ) , although heads differ in how strongly they respond to the query. We therefore ask: Can query-sensitive heads be identified with a training-free criterion?
blocks.zh: 几种LLM中推法平均对所有头部的文字到视觉的注意(Chen等人)。 2024 ; Takezoe et al. 2026 ),虽然头部对询问的响应程度不同. 因此,我们问:能否以无培训标准确定对询问敏感的头?

blocks.en: A concentrated attention distribution has high variance across visual tokens, but concentration alone does not imply query sensitivity. We therefore test whether attention variance ranks heads whose visual-token attention changes more with the question. We pair 1,000 TextVQA ( Singh et al. 2019 ) images with two distinct questions and process them using LLaVA-1.5-7B. At each layer, we rank the 32 heads by the variance of their text-to-vision attention and evaluate cumulative top-4, top-8, top-12, and all-head subsets. Let 𝐬 h ( 1 ) \mathbf{s}_{h}^{(1)} and 𝐬 h ( 2 ) \mathbf{s}_{h}^{(2)} be the visual-token attention distributions of head h h for the two questions. We define its textual sensitivity as TS h = 1 − cos ⁡ ( 𝐬 h ( 1 ) , 𝐬 h ( 2 ) ) . \operatorname{TS}_{h}=1-\cos\!\left(\mathbf{s}_{h}^{(1)},\mathbf{s}_{h}^{(2)}\right). (1)

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a) shows that the highest-variance subsets are generally more text-sensitive, with the clearest separation in the middle layers. Since the subsets are cumulative, the decrease from top-4 to all 32 heads shows that adding lower-ranked heads reduces the mean per-head sensitivity. Attention variance therefore provides a simple criterion for selecting query-sensitive heads.
blocks.zh: 图3(a)显示,最高变异子集一般对文字更为敏感,中间层的分离最为清晰. 由于子集是累积的,从前四位到所有32位头的减少表明,增加排名较低的头会降低平均人均灵敏度. 因此,注意力差异为选择对查询敏感的头提供了简单的标准.

blocks.en: Figure 3 (b) compares average text-to-vision attention across visual-token positions at different layers. In the earliest layers, attention generally increases with token position, favoring visual tokens closer to the subsequent text sequence. Although all layers exhibit peaks near the sequence boundaries, later layers show flatter profiles across the interior positions, suggesting weaker positional dependence. This observation motivates delaying attention-based pruning beyond the earliest layers.
blocks.zh: 图3(b)比较不同层次的可视化台位置的平均文字对视觉的注意。 在最早的层中,注意力一般随着符号位置而增加,倾向于视觉符号更接近随后的文本序列. 虽然所有地层都展现出靠近序列边界的峰值,但后来的地层则展现出横跨内部位置的奉承图谱,表明位置依赖性较弱. 这种观察促使基于注意力的钻探延迟到最早的层外.

blocks.en: Together, these analyses motivate two design choices: using high-variance heads for query-sensitive token scoring and pruning at a shallow-to-middle layer to avoid strong early-layer position dependence.
blocks.zh: 这些分析一起激发了两种设计选择:使用高变量头来进行对查询敏感的符号评分和在浅层到中层进行挤压,以避免强烈的早期位置依赖.

Stage 2 uses high-variance attention heads to retain K 2 K_{2} query-relevant tokens at a shallow-to-middle LLM layer. The following subsections detail the two stages.

blocks.en: Overall, the two stages form a progressive query-aware pruning process. By introducing textual relevance into pre-LLM pruning, TReVS preserves query-relevant visual evidence before irreversible reduction, ensuring that the subsequent in-LLM stage operates on an informative visual context. Within the LLM, high-variance heads provide more discriminative text-to-vision attention, enabling the in-LLM stage to better retain task-relevant visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这两个阶段形成了一个渐进的了解查询的浏览过程。 通过将文本相关性引入LLM预读,TReVS在不可逆转的还原之前保留了与查询相关的视觉证据,确保之后的LLM阶段在信息化的视觉上运行. 在LLM内部,高变异头提供更加歧视性的文本对视觉的注意,使LLM阶段能够更好地保留与任务相关的视觉符号.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate TReVS across image, high-resolution, and video understanding to examine whether its query-aware two-stage design remains effective across different visual-token lengths. We then analyze its inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们评价TReVS跨图像,高分辨率,和视频理解,以检查其有查询意识的两阶段设计在不同的视觉音箱长度上是否依然有效. 然后我们分析它的推论效率。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models and benchmarks. We evaluate TReVS on LLaVA-1.5-7B ( Liu et al. 2024a ) , LLaVA-NeXT-7B ( Liu et al. 2024b ) , and Video-LLaVA-7B ( Lin et al. 2023 ) , which process 576, 2,880 and 2,048 visual tokens, respectively. For LLaVA-1.5-7B, we use GQA ( Hudson and Manning 2019 ) , ScienceQA-IMG ( Lu et al. 2022 ) , TextVQA ( Singh et al. 2019 ) , POPE ( Li et al. 2023b ) , MME ( Fu et al. 2023 ) , and the English and Chinese splits of MMBench ( Liu et al. 2024c ) . We evaluate LLaVA-NeXT-7B on GQA, TextVQA, MME, and MMBench, and Video-LLaVA-7B on TGIF-QA ( Jang et al. 2017 ) , MSVD-QA, and MSRVTT-QA ( Xu et al. 2017 ) .

Unless otherwise specified, we perform the second pruning stage after the eighth LLM layer and retain the top half of the attention heads according to their text-to-vision attention variance. We set the ratio between pivot and diversity tokens to K r : K d = 3 : 1 K_{r}:K_{d}=3:1 and maintain K 1 : K 2 = 3 : 1 K_{1}:K_{2}=3:1 between the two pruning stages. The visual and textual temperatures are set to τ v = 1.4 \tau_{v}=1.4 and τ t = 1.0 \tau_{t}=1.0 , respectively. The consistency-reward weight is set to λ = 1.0 \lambda=1.0 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Tables 1 , 2 , and 3 compare TReVS with existing visual token pruning methods across image and video VLMs.
blocks.zh: 表1,表2和表3比较了TReVS与现有视觉符号的穿透图像和视频VLM的推敲方法.

blocks.en: Results on LLaVA-1.5-7B. As shown in Table 1 , TReVS achieves the highest RelAcc. at all three budgets, retaining 98.8%, 96.5%, and 92.8% of the unpruned performance. Notably, TReVS consistently obtains the best MME scores across these budgets, which indicates stable preservation of visual evidence required for diverse perception and cognition tasks. Moreover, its margin over the second-best RelAcc. increases from 0.6% at 128 tokens to 1.2% at 32 tokens. This widening margin is consistent with the two-stage design of TReVS. Before the LLM, textual relevance prioritizes query-relevant tokens, reducing critical information loss when only a small number of tokens can be retained. Within the LLM, query-sensitive heads provide more discriminative attention for selecting task-relevant tokens, making more effective use of the limited remaining token budget.
blocks.zh: 关于LLaVA-1.5-7B的结果。 如表1所示,TReVS在所有三个预算中都取得了最高的RelAcc.,保留了98.8%、96.5%和92.8%的未加工业绩。 值得注意的是,TReVS在这些预算中一贯获得最佳的MME分数,这表明稳定地保存了各种认知和认知任务所需的视觉证据。 此外,它对于第二好成绩的RelAcc的比值从0.6%的128个信使增加到1.2%的32个信使。 这种扩大的比值符合TReVS的两阶段设计. 在LLM之前,文本相关性会优先排列与查询相关的符号,当仅能保留少量的符号时会减少关键信息损失. 在LLM中,对查询敏感的头为选择与任务相关的符号提供了更多的歧视性关注,更有效地使用有限的剩余符号预算.

blocks.en: Hallucination robustness. Figure 5 compares POPE performance across token budgets. While the methods perform similarly at moderate budgets, TReVS achieves 82.7% accuracy with 32 tokens, outperforming DivPrune and VScan by 1.2% and 2.8%. This robustness is consistent with our query-aware pre-LLM design, which preserves evidence for queried objects before irreversible pruning and thereby mitigates hallucinations caused by missing visual evidence.

blocks.en: Results on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. Table 2 evaluates TReVS on the longer visual sequences produced by high-resolution inputs. TReVS achieves the highest RelAcc. at both budgets, retaining 96.6% and 93.0% of the unpruned performance with 320 and 160 tokens, respectively. The best MME scores at both budgets and the best MMB score at 160 tokens further show that TReVS preserves key visual evidence under substantial compression. Despite these overall gains, TReVS trails the best GQA results by 0.5% and 0.6% under high-resolution inputs, whereas the gap is less pronounced with lower-resolution inputs. GQA requires global reasoning over multiple objects and their relations, and such evidence may be distributed across longer visual sequences. We hypothesize that high-variance heads prioritize sparse query-relevant details and therefore retain slightly less global context, making this trade-off more evident at higher resolutions.
blocks.zh: LLaVA-NEXT-7B的结果. 表2评价TReVS通过高分辨率输入产生的更长的视觉序列. TReVS在两个预算中都实现了最高的RelAcc.,保留了96.6%和93.0%的未刷音的成绩,分别为320个和160个令牌. 两种预算的最佳MME分数和160令牌的最佳MMB分数进一步表明TReVS在大量压缩下保存了关键视觉证据. 尽管取得了这些总体收益,但TReVS在高分辨率投入下取得了0.5%和0.6%的最佳全球质量评估结果,而低分辨率投入下的差距并不明显。 GQA要求对多个物体及其关系进行全球推理,这种证据可能分布在更长的视觉序列中. 我们假设,高差异头头优先处理与查询有关的稀有细节,因此保留的全球背景略少,使这种取舍在更高分辨率上更加明显。

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4 isolates the contributions of the two pruning stages under the 32-token preset. Replacing [CLS]-attention-only pre-LLM pruning with the first stage of TReVS improves RelAcc. from 91.8% to 92.7% while retaining all attention heads in the second stage. This gain confirms that combining textual relevance with visual saliency and token diversity better preserves query-relevant and complementary evidence before irreversible token reduction. Selecting high-variance heads further increases RelAcc. to 93.2%, demonstrating that high-variance heads provide more discriminative query-aware signals than uniformly using all heads. Together, the two stages improve RelAcc. by 1.4%, confirming their complementary roles in preventing premature information loss and removing residual task-irrelevant tokens.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work identifies an irreversible information bottleneck in two-stage visual token pruning: query-agnostic pre-LLM reduction can discard task-relevant evidence before query-aware reasoning begins. We introduce TReVS, a training-free framework that coordinates vision-encoder saliency, textual relevance, token diversity, and high-variance attention heads across pre-LLM and in-LLM pruning. Our findings highlight two key principles for effective visual token pruning: preserving query-relevant evidence before the LLM and using query-sensitive attention heads to identify task-relevant tokens within the LLM. Future work may explore adaptive token allocation between the pre-LLM and in-LLM stages based on input complexity and query demands.
blocks.zh: 这项工作在两阶段的视觉符号搜索中识别出一个不可逆转的信息瓶颈:查询-不可知的LLM预还原可以在查询-意识到推理开始前丢弃与任务相关的证据. 我们引入了TReVS,这是一个无培训框架,它协调视觉编码的显著性,文字相关性,象征多样性,以及跨LLM前和LLM内运行的高差异关注头. 我们的研究结果突出了有效的视觉符号搜索的两个关键原则:在LLM前保存与查询相关的证据,并利用对查询敏感的注意头在LLM内识别与任务相关的符号. 今后的工作可能根据输入的复杂性和查询需求,探索在LLM前阶段和LLM内阶段之间的适应符号分配。
